_help: Hand edited fixes for data lag. action is add, remove or set. iata and reason are required. An add needs airline. A remove without airline drops every airline on that route. A set needs airline and kind, and changes the kind of a route Wikipedia already lists. review_by flags the entry once that date passes.

overrides.reason: Seasonal route, paused right now, so Wikipedia dropped it. FlyPDX still lists it.
Wikipedia says year round, but BTS on time data shows flights only from about February to August in 2024, 2025 and 2026. See docs/exceptions.md.
